items.name: Catalan Chicken Sandwich
items.description: Chicken thighs are first marinated in red wine with capers, olives, garlic, and onions. They are then oven-roasted, sliced, and served on ciabatta or focaccia with an olive-based sauce and fresh tomatoes. Before serving, the sandwich is toasted on a panini press until golden and crispy.
